title: How Roche's Founder Shared His Firm to Save It in 1919
conflicts: Founder's stake after the 1919 conversion: Roche's history says he kept only a minority; the International Directory of Company Histories says he supplied 3 of 4 million francs (implying a majority); SRF (2021) places the family's loss of majority after his death, when capital was doubled. The story states no 1919 stake and attributes the 1920s shareholding to SRF. The Directory's 'more than 1 million francs' Russian loss is unconfirmed and omitted. Russia as 'biggest' (Roche) vs 'second-largest' (RSU) market: attributed to Roche.
notes: Built on Roche's own archive history, the NDB biography (1972) and SRF; the Directory is used only where another source agrees, since it contains errors. No first-hand statement by Hoffmann was found, so the story reports actions only.
